map: accelerated Collatz: x/2 for even x; (3*x+1)/2 for odd x

representative_start_range.rule: least n >= 3 in each residue class modulo 2^horizon

interpretation.guaranteed_drop_class_count: Classes whose least n>=3 representative drops by the horizon; the positive affine slope makes every larger member drop by the same or an earlier step.
interpretation.least_representative_no_drop_class_count: Classes whose least representative is an explicit counterexample. The independent affine audit partitions these into mixed classes, where sufficiently large members drop by the horizon, and no-member-drop classes.
interpretation.fully_covered: Every admitted least representative drops by the horizon, so all starts n>=3 in the admitted classes do too.
interpretation.ordinary_steps: If the first accelerated drop is at t after h odd inputs, the first ordinary drop is at t+h.
interpretation.member_classification: all_member_drop_class_count counts classes where every n>=3 in the residue class drops by the horizon; mixed_member_class_count counts classes with a finite set of smaller non-dropping starts and a later drop; no_member_drop_class_count counts classes with no drop by the horizon for any member.

member_classification_source.method: symbolic parity-prefix affine thresholds, independent of representative orbit simulation
